svg.title: Reflection and guardrails pipeline
svg.desc: A pandas tool turns sales.csv into metrics. Claude writes an analysis, a reflection step checks it for correctness and a guardrail checks it is safe to release. Only an analysis that passes both is released; every run is written to an audit log and an HTML report.
svg.text: A sales-analysis agent that checks its own work and blocks claims the data cannot support
Audit log + HTML report, every run
metrics, analysis, both verdicts and the release decision · reports/run-*.json · report-*.html
Demo: python agent.py --demo-block injects an unsupported claim after step 1, and both gates catch it.
